data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"A test constrains its subject only when the test's failure is a necessary condition for the subject's installation, and the 3-of-26 result shows that necessity is not established for most compile.py mutations (only 1/9) but is established by construction for the ordinarily-guarded modules (4/4 to 6/7), meaning the distribution is a measure of where necessity was installed rather than a property of the subjects.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If a mutation is lost despite no shown-to-fail-first test preceding it, necessity is not the operative condition.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If a shown-to-fail-first test exists but the mutation is still accepted (not lost), then passing the test was not necessary in that case.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 1-of-9 compile.py loss was caused by a static check unrelated to shown-to-fail-first installation, the necessity mechanism would not explain it.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the 4/4 to 6/7 losses are due to mutations that are semantically equivalent rather than caught by necessity, the distribution would be misattributed.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Necessity is installed by shown-to-fail-first: if the test is shown to fail before the mutation is introduced, then passing the test becomes a necessary condition for accepting the mutation. This is not a description of the subject but a constraint imposed on the installation process. In compile.py, only one mutation's path was preceded by a shown-to-fail-first test, so necessity was established for only 1 of 9. In the ordinarily-guarded modules, the tests were installed fail-first across the module, so necessity was established for 4/4 to 6/7 mutations. The condition under which a test constrains its subject is therefore: the test's failure has been demonstrated before the subject's change is accepted, making test passage necessary for installation.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
